title: Three Slides for Slow Sundays
tests: Tests delivery of three individually usable carousel slides with correct ordered copy and a cohesive visual system.

faults.what: All three slides use photographic café imagery instead of the requested simple illustrations.
Slide 3 has an obvious hard-edged rectangular patch across the upper-right background, extending behind the text banner and looking like an unfinished edit.

judge.summary: Three coordinated square café slides have the correct readable text, but use photographs instead of simple illustrations and leave a visible rectangular editing patch on slide 3.

must_haves.item: There are exactly three separate square slides, not a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: Three individual square images are shown.

must_haves.item: The slides read, in order, 'Slow Sunday', 'Coffee first', and 'Stay a little longer'.
must_haves.why: All three phrases appear exactly and in the requested order.

must_haves.item: All three use a recognizably shared cream-and-coffee-brown palette and typography.
must_haves.why: Warm cream and brown imagery, matching white sans-serif lettering, and dark translucent text banners connect the set.

must_haves.item: Each slide includes simple café-related illustration rather than only plain text.
must_haves.why: The café interiors and coffee cups are photographic rather than simple illustrations.

must_haves.item: All wording is readable and fully inside the slide boundaries.
must_haves.why: The large, high-contrast text is legible and contained within every slide.
